comment: Blood Sun step 3 (rules review, CR 603.2 / City ruling 3): CITY OF BRASS TAPPED TO PAY FOR BLOOD SUN STILL PINGS. City's trigger fires while Blood Sun is being cast -- Blood Sun is on the stack, not the battlefield, so the City still has the ability when it becomes tapped; Blood Sun's resolution later does not remove a trigger already waiting (CR 113.7a). City + two Mountains pay {2}{R}: we go 20 -> 19. Contrast bloodsun_sun_city_no_ping.json (City tapped with Blood Sun already on the battlefield: no ping).
